}}'''Pedra''' is an [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Pedra}}

== Appearance and Attitude ==
She is short and wiry with a serious face. She is a little older than [[Nynaeve]], around 27 years old. Egwene didn't like her the first time they met because of Pedra's excessive officiousness.

Men make Pedra nervous. {{ref/book|10|22}}

== Strength ==
Nowhere it is stated the potential strength of Pedra. But because of her age and the fact that she will be tested for the shawl very shortly, it can be calculated that her years in training have been in total around 12-13 (or even less), around the same training time of Aes Sedai at level {{opsl|23}}.

== History ==
Pevara and Tarna commented that when Pedra came to the [[White Tower]] it seemed like she would not make it very far, but has since proven herself capable. {{ref/book|10|22}}

== Activities ==
She escorts [[Egwene al'Vere]] to her room, when Egwene first arrives to the White Tower.{{ref/book|2|24}}

After the Tower split Pedra remains in the Tower and is seen serving on [[Pevara Tazanovni]] when [[Tarna Feir]] arrives. She serves them wine and cakes. The two Aes Sedai comment that Pedra is almost ready to be tested for the shawl, but she will not chose the [[Red Ajah]], due her attitude to the men.

Later she is leading the [[Novices]] to class, when their classroom vanished and they get lost in the White Tower, due to the shifting walls. Pedra is so frightened by it that showed it by being cross with the novices, which is very unusual for her.

== Speculation ==
It can be guessed that after reunification Pedra was tested for the shawl and maybe now is a full Aes Sedai.
